description: The file contains unit tests for the TailscaleServeGatewayDiscovery component, testing its discovery logic, executable resolution, and environment setup.

methods.name: discovers serve gateway from tailnet peers
methods.description: Asynchronously tests discovery of a serve gateway from tailnet peer statuses.

methods.name: returns empty when status unavailable
methods.description: Checks that discovery returns an empty list when the tailnet status is unavailable.

methods.name: resolves bare executable from PATH
methods.description: Verifies that the executable path resolution correctly finds an executable present in the PATH.

methods.name: rejects missing executable candidate
methods.description: Ensures that missing executables are not resolved and return nil.

methods.name: adds TERM for GUI-launched tailscale subprocesses
methods.description: Tests that the environment setup adds TERM variable when launching a tailscale subprocess.

methods.name: preserves existing TERM when building tailscale subprocess environment
methods.description: Checks that existing TERM environment variable is preserved when constructing the environment for tailscale processes.
